title: Scalar curvature of blow-ups of compact Kähler manifolds along complex submanifolds
summary: Let $(M,ω)$ be a compact Kähler manifold with its scalar curvature $S(ω)$, Assume that $M$ has complex dimension at least $3$ and contains a complex submanifold $X$ of complex codimension at least $2$. Let $σ: Bl_{X} M \rightarrow M$ denote the blow-up of $M$ along $X$. We show that $Bl_{X} M$ admits a sequence of Kähler metrics $\{\widetildeω_{i}\}_{i \geq 1}$ whose scalar curvatures $S(\widetildeω_i)$ converge to $σ^{\ast} (S(ω))$ in the $C^0(Bl_{X} M)$ norm. Our work is motivated by a recent result of Brown, who established the corresponding result for blow-ups at a point. The proof is…
